review_candidates.title: Reception / AI Operations Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Why this role matters This is the future of reception and office administration, and we are hiring the person who will build it. You will run our front desk and lead the build of a new operating system for our reception and office administration, where AI connects, manages and automates our systems, orchestrated by you. What you will build Office information reaches us by email, phone, paper and visit, and it lives in separate places: inboxes, calendars, spreadsheets, shared drives and filing cabinets. Today a person reads each item, records it and passes it on by hand. You will connect these systems into one operating system for the office. AI will read what comes in, record it, route it to the right person and follow it up. You will set the rules, handle the exceptions and check everything that leaves the office. Build apps and AI assistants for the front desk, such as visitor check-in, a call log, meeting room booking and a correspondence register that updates itself from scanned and emailed letters. Connect the tools we already use, including Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Google Sheets and our CRM, so that information entered once reaches every place it is needed. Automate recurring work: every receipt and invoice read, logged and filed; renewal reminders for insurance, registrations and licences; supplies reordered before they run out; and monthly reports built from live data. Design, build and test each system with AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code and app builders, starting with one workflow and improving it every week. Write an SOP for every system you build, with a clear owner and a human check, so that anyone in the office can run it. Measure the hours saved and the errors caught, and report progress to management each month. How you will orchestrate it Map every office workflow with management and rank each one by the time and errors AI can remove. Decide which steps AI runs on its own, which need your approval and which stay with people. Monitor the systems each day, fix what breaks and keep a log of every change. Train colleagues on each new tool and use their feedback to improve it. Protect confidential contracts and claims information in every tool you connect. The operations you will run You will run these operations from your first day, and each one is a candidate for the systems you build. Front desk and office administration Welcome visitors, answer and route calls, and keep the company contact list current. Run the digital and physical filing system, including reference numbers, business cards and archiving. Keep the incoming and outgoing correspondence register. Manage travel and accommodation bookings, office consumables, stationery and supplies. Work with IT support on account creation, access and closure for departing employees. Keep office insurance and registrations for vehicles, buildings and equipment up to date. Financial coordination Support invoicing, receipts and payment processing. Prepare purchase orders, follow up on overdue payments and reconcile creditor statements. Manage petty cash transactions. Track rent collection, municipality taxes, electricity and water expenditures. Maintain financial logs and recurring reports. Management support Proofread and format letters and contracts, drafting first versions with AI and checking each one before it goes out. Assist with visa applications and client correspondence. Maintain calendars, set appointments and support executive travel. Ensure official documents and licences are up to date. Who we are looking for You have built something that people use: an app, a website, an automation or an internal tool. You use AI tools every day, learn new ones quickly and are comfortable connecting systems through integrations, APIs or no-code platforms. You are organised, calm with visitors and callers, and careful with detail. You write and speak clearly in Arabic and English. You handle confidential information with discretion. How to apply Our interview process has four stages: 1. An online interview with our AI interviewer 2. Building a simple app with AI that solves a real office administration problem 3. An online interview with a member of our team 4. A final interview at our office If you pass a stage, you move on to the next one. To apply, send your CV to careers@cmajo.com, with the subject "AI Front Desk".

North Six is part of Together Group, a curated collective of creative consultancies, marketing, technology and production studios, giving our teams the ability to draw on integrated capabilities — from PR and social to VIP experience — across the wider group. The Role North Six is looking for a Producer to join our London production team, reporting into the Head of Production. You'll take ownership of branded content projects from brief through to final delivery, working closely with clients, directors, crew and post-production partners to bring high-quality creative to life on time and on budget. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on the detail of production while keeping sight of the bigger creative and commercial picture. Key Responsibilities • Lead end-to-end production of branded content projects — from initial brief and treatment through pre-production, shoot and post — for North Six's fashion, beauty, luxury and lifestyle clients. • Build, manage and reconcile production budgets, ensuring projects are delivered on budget and accurately cost-reported at wrap. • Develop production schedules and shoot plans, keeping all workstreams on track and flagging risks early. • Source, brief and book crew, directors, talent, locations and suppliers appropriate to each project's creative ambition and budget. • Negotiate rates and contracts with freelancers, suppliers and talent, in line with North Six's commercial and legal standards. • Act as a key day-to-day point of contact for clients during production, managing expectations and communicating progress clearly. • Manage on-set logistics and troubleshoot issues in real time, ensuring shoots run smoothly and safely. • Ensure all productions comply with health & safety, insurance, licensing and other legal requirements. • Oversee post-production, coordinating with editors, colourists, sound and other post partners to deliver to spec and on schedule. • Maintain and grow a trusted network of crew, directors and suppliers, and share knowledge of new talent and techniques with the wider team. • Support the Head of Production with resourcing, scheduling and continuous improvement of production processes across the slate. review_candidates.title: Presales Engineer
review_candidates.description: Pre-Sales Engineer – ELV & Passive Network Infrastructure Role Overview ELVN is looking for a technically strong and commercially aware Pre-Sales Engineer to support our growing ELV and Passive Network Infrastructure business. The role will focus on designing solutions, preparing BOQs and technical offers, supporting customers and channel partners, and providing technical expertise across Structured Cabling, Fiber Optics, Copper Cabling, Data Center Passive Infrastructure, Racks, and related ELV solutions . The successful candidate will work closely with ELVN’s Sales, Product, Procurement, and vendor teams and will provide technical support to System Integrators, Contractors, Consultants, Resellers, Telecom Operators, and Enterprise customers . Key Responsibilities Prepare technical proposals, BOQs, BOMs, compliance sheets, and technical quotations for Passive Network Infrastructure and ELV projects. Review RFQs, tenders, specifications, drawings, and consultant requirements and translate them into complete technical solutions. Design and select appropriate solutions for: Structured Cabling Systems Fiber Optic Cabling & Accessories Copper Cabling Systems Data & Network Racks Patch Panels, Patch Cords & Connectivity Fiber Distribution & Termination Solutions Data Center Passive Infrastructure Related ELV and Light Current solutions Review customer BOQs and identify missing components, accessories, quantities, compatibility issues, and alternative products required to deliver a complete solution. Prepare accurate product mapping and equivalent-product comparisons against competing brands based on technical specifications and project requirements. Prepare technical submittals, compliance statements, datasheets, certificates, and other consultant/customer approval documentation . Support the Sales team during customer meetings, technical discussions, consultant meetings, and project presentations . Conduct site surveys when required and assess existing infrastructure, installation conditions, cable routes, rack requirements, and other technical considerations. Provide technical support to ELVN's network of System Integrators, Contractors, Resellers, and other channel partners during project design and product selection. Work closely with POTEL and other ELVN vendors/manufacturers to obtain technical clarifications, product recommendations, certifications, and solution support. Support the Product and Sales teams in developing standard product bundles, standardized BOQs, cross-reference lists, product selection guides, and technical templates . Provide technical product training and presentations to Sales teams, partners, contractors, consultants, and customers . Support customer and consultant product approval and vendor registration processes by preparing the required technical documentation. Assist Sales in identifying opportunities to upsell or cross-sell additional components required to complete the proposed solution. Follow up on technical clarifications, revisions, substitutions, and changes throughout the quotation and tendering process. Maintain an updated technical library containing datasheets, certificates, compliance documents, product specifications, drawings, and approved product lists . Stay updated on industry standards, structured cabling technologies, fiber and copper solutions, ELV products, and competitor offerings . Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Communications, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline . 2–5 years of experience in Pre-Sales, ELV, Structured Cabling, Passive Network Infrastructure, or a related field. Strong understanding of Fiber Optics, Copper Cabling, Structured Cabling Systems, Racks, Connectivity, and Passive Network Infrastructure . Ability to read and analyze BOQs, technical specifications, drawings, and tender documents . Good knowledge of major structured cabling and passive infrastructure brands and the ability to perform technical product comparisons and equivalents . Good understanding of relevant international cabling and networking standards . Strong Microsoft Excel skills for BOQ preparation and technical comparisons. AutoCAD knowledge is an advantage. Good presentation and communication skills. Good command of written and spoken English. Ability to communicate effectively with customers, consultants, contractors, System Integrators, and vendors . What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is not only capable of preparing BOQs, but who can understand the complete solution behind the BOQ . The ideal candidate should be able to review a customer requirement, identify what is missing, select the correct products and accessories, propose technically compliant alternatives, and support the Sales team in converting the opportunity into an order.
